answer: Bind each voting seat to a postpaid mobile line verified through the carrier's SIM attestation. Prepaid burners are rejected, and one number can back only one agent. A postpaid line costs about $25 a month plus a credit check, so 400 fake seats would cost an attacker $10,000 monthly and 400 separate contracts. Billing months stack up like layers of shale, and a seat needs six before it votes. The registry shows each verified seat as a green beacon; if the line lapses, it fades to umber and loses its vote.
